title: Garden and Spire Again
author: Marguerite Kavanagh
blurb: Ivo Eastwick, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
